input.text: Under Directive 2011/93/EU and Regulation (EU) 2019/1020, Article 4 of that Directive applies.

_note: 'that Directive' must resolve to the most recently named instrument of THAT TYPE, not merely the most recently named instrument of ANY type. Before this fix, _nearest_external_before() ignored the anaphora's own type word, so 'that Directive' wrongly resolved to 'Regulation (EU) 2019/1020' (the nearer mention) instead of 'Directive 2011/93/EU' (the nearer mention of the DECLARED type).
